title: Re-instantiated atom exponent at the toll edge on the searched pair module: conditional κ = 5.557315e-4
body:
## Conditional improvement

$$T(n)=O\big(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}\big),\qquad \kappa=\frac{1111463}{2000000000}=\mathbf{5.557315}\times10^{-4}.$$

**Stacked on #157** (`6741112`, eumemic's paired cubes at p = 11 with a searched pair module, physical frames and a paired-cube bit word). Please review/merge that dependency first; its changes are not claimed here. The only files of this branch are `research/paired-cube-toll-edge/` (README, verifier). The branch carries a single squashed commit on main because the push credential lacks workflow scope; relative to #157 the diff is exactly those two files.

## Change

One assembly instantiation constant is re-chosen. #157 inherits the merged #144 atom exponent `1/1000`. The atom exponent theta is a free positive constant of the retained assembly: it enters only through `ab = (1-theta)*COARSE + theta*OLD` and the strict toll `ab < theta < 1-ab`. #157's bit side binds (`COARSE = 5566382/10^10` below the complex saving `5622769/10^10`), so raising `ab` onto the binding face moves kappa directly. `ab` strictly increases in theta while kappa strictly decreases across the acceptance window, so the grid-maximal instantiation is the first 10^-12-grid point where the strict toll holds — exactly one step above `theta* = COARSE/(1+COARSE-OLD)`:

| | atom exponent | kappa |
|---|---:|---:|
| #157 (inherited) | 1/1000 | 5555021/10^10 |
| this branch | 556349912/10^12 | **1111463/2*10^9** (+2294 grid points) |

The phase-stop stays at #157's inherited 1/10^6: it is slack at this face (the binding bit value sits below the `(1-beta)*AC - 10^-10` ceiling). The same re-instantiation genre, at the same constants, is #148's toll tightening and #153's phase-stop re-instantiation. No word, frame, pair, certificate or interface changes; every inherited interface remains an assumption exactly as in #157.

## Verification

`python3 research/paired-cube-toll-edge/verify.py` (stdlib, ~2 min; do not use `-O`): reproduces #157's published 5555021/10^10 exactly at the inherited constants (running #157's own producer, physical record, certificates, bridge and assembly), checks one 10^-12 step below the new theta violates the strict toll, then re-runs #157's 47-constraint assembly at theta = 556349912/10^12: kappa = 1111463/2000000000, next 10^-10 grid point rejected, all 47 strict constraints positive, 7 margins.

- Re-instantiation and this package: Abhinav Ramachandran with Hermes (Nous Research) assistance.

Conditional; no unconditional multiplication theorem is claimed. Failed next-grid upper-enclosure tests mean only the failure of that certificate, not a mathematical optimality result.
